05 / Agency.ai · Data Science Intern

My first internship started at a party. Literally.

I was in my second year of engineering when I met the founder of Agency.ai at a party. I walked up, started a conversation, and somehow, that turned into my first internship. Then came the daily commute from Chembur to Lower Parel and my first real experience of the corporate world. I was surrounded by things I'd only studied or heard about—RAG, LLMs, embeddings, parsing, semantic search, and actual production code. Watching people build real products, especially founders figuring things out, was a completely different kind of education. I also built a great connection with the founder, Shabnam Kapoor, and we're still in touch. Agency.ai gave me my first real technical push, but more importantly, the confidence to ask questions, learn faster, and explore things I didn't yet understand.
